Shadows

A layered shadow scale to create depth, elevate interactive elements, and emphasize surfaces.

Shadow Scale

Apply any shadow with a single utility class, from none to extra large.

Scale
shadow-none
shadow-xs
shadow-sm
shadow-md
shadow-lg
shadow-xl
shadow-2xl
shadow-inner
css 
--zak-shadow-xs:    0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
--zak-shadow-sm:    0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
--zak-shadow-md:    0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
--zak-shadow-lg:    0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
--zak-shadow-xl:    0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1);
--zak-shadow-2xl:   0 25px 50px -12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25);
--zak-shadow-inner: inset 0 2px 4px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05);
--zak-shadow-none:  0 0 #0000;

/* Utility classes */
.zak-shadow-none .zak-shadow-xs .zak-shadow-sm .zak-shadow-md
.zak-shadow-lg .zak-shadow-xl .zak-shadow-2xl .zak-shadow-inner

Usage Examples

Cards with progressively larger shadows to communicate hierarchy and elevation.

Cards
shadow-sm

Flat, subtle card for static content.

shadow-md

Default elevation for most surfaces.

shadow-xl

High elevation for modals and popovers.

html 
<div class="zak-shadow-sm">Flat content card</div>
<div class="zak-shadow-md">Default elevation</div>
<div class="zak-shadow-xl">Modal / popover</div>

Colored Shadows

Emphasize a card with a subtle colored shadow using the shadow as a starting point.

Colored
Primary

Branded highlight.

Success

Positive emphasis.

Danger

Warning emphasis.

css 
/* Combine a base shadow with a colored accent */
.card-primary {
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -5px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--zak-primary-500);
}
.card-success {
  box-shadow: 0 10px 20px -5px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--zak-success-500);
}

Hover Shadows

Create interactive elevation with a shadow that deepens on hover.

Hover
css 
/* Use the built-in helper, or write your own */
.custom-card {
  transition: box-shadow var(--zak-transition-base), transform var(--zak-transition-base);
}
.custom-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--zak-shadow-xl);
  transform: translateY(-4px);
}

/* Built-in helper classes */
.zak-hover-lift:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--zak-shadow-md); }
.zak-hover-zoom:hover { transform: scale(1.05); }

Accessibility

  • Shadows should be purely decorative — never use shadow depth as the only indicator of interactivity; add hover/focus states.
  • Ensure contrast between elevated surfaces and their background remains sufficient in light and dark themes.
  • Consider prefers-reduced-motion — avoid animated shadow/transform transitions for users who prefer motion reduction.
  • Floating elements (modals, dropdowns) need to remain distinguishable; combine shadow with a border or stronger elevation.
